sources.title: Graph API overview
sources.supports: Default list replacement; add_messages appends new IDs and updates matching IDs; MessagesState uses this reducer.

sources.title: Memory
sources.supports: Checkpointed state and model input are separate; trimming model input need not delete state; context windows require token-aware policies.

sources.title: ChatAnthropic integration
sources.supports: invoke accepts message lists and returns AIMessage; content may be blocks; usage_metadata is retained; provider token counting uses a remote API.

limitations: Authoring validation is offline only with explicit test doubles; parent must run real Anthropic demonstration and solution and record evidence.
Fresh-history invocation simulates application reset; no actual cross-process model restart test is claimed.
History remains process-local and is carried by the caller. Text logs are readable exports, not automatic reloads or durable checkpoints; see U1.
The exercise bounds model-input message count only, not tokens, total transcript size, file size, or retained facts.
Only alternating HumanMessage/AIMessage text-chat turns are supported; system and tool message trimming needs a separate policy.
Prior AI replies can repeat facts from omitted turns, so trimming the original human turn does not guarantee forgetting or privacy erasure.
Raw transcripts may contain sensitive or role-like multiline content; use synthetic inputs. Logs are not an unambiguous parsing format, encrypted store, or concurrent-session persistence layer.
No source figures, rendered diagrams, live screenshots, Windows validation, telemetry requests, or dashboard validation were performed by the lesson author.
